name: Phyrexian negators
description: Phyrexian creatures Kerrick brought into the Academy and later bred in great numbers.

description_citations.text: "K'rrik". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn sees Kerrick stealing blueprints from Urza's lab and follows him to a secret Phyrexian meeting where he overhears the invasion plans.
timeline.quote: Karn overheard the Phyrexian's plans to invade the Academy

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick brings negators into the Academy, and they slaughter students and teachers, including Jhoira.
timeline.quote: Kerrick had brought Phyrexian negators into the Academy.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn finds Jhoira's corpse and slays her killer, a negator; Urza tells him Barrin and Teferi are dead too and sends him back in time.
timeline.quote: Karn then fought and slew Jhoira's killer, a Phyrexian negator.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick survives in a fast-time rift, builds a Phyrexian fortress and army, and renames himself K'rrik, lord of the fortress.
timeline.quote: he renamed himself K'rrik and became the lord of that fortress

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Lord of the fortress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani lends Urza his strength and together they kill K'rrik; Multani animates Tolaria's forests to destroy the remaining negators.
timeline.quote: Multani lent Urza his strength and killed the Phyrexian together

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "K'rrik's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: lord of the fortress who raised generations of negators
relations.quote: He was able to spawn generations of Phyrexian Negators in one year

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Lord of the fortress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
